title: Star Trek Scotty Mug Cup Hamilton Gifts P7518 Vintage Planet Earth Exclusive1991
categoryName: Collectibles:Science Fiction & Horror:Star Trek Collectibles:Other Star Trek Collectibles
descriptionText:
This unique mug is a must-have for any Star Trek fan! Featuring the iconic character Scotty from The Original Series, this Hamilton Gifts mug is a vintage collectible from 1991. The mug is made in Korea, Republic of and is exclusive to the Star Trek Communicator series. 

The cup is perfect for tea or coffee and is a great addition to any sci-fi or horror collection. The design is eye-catching and the quality of the mug is excellent. This item is a featured refinement for collectors of Star Trek memorabilia and is sure to be a prized possession for years to come.
